title: Services
hint: The programs that make up the box. Restarting one interrupts it for a few seconds.
entryHint: Check the programs that make up the box and restart one.
selfRestartWarning: Restarting Calaos server disconnects this page for about 30 seconds. It reconnects by itself.
loadFailed: The list of services could not be read.
confirmHint: It stops for a few seconds and starts again. Whatever relies on it waits meanwhile.
runHint: It runs once now instead of waiting for its next scheduled run.
selfRestarting: Calaos server is restarting. This page reconnects by itself, then checks that it came back.
upgrading: An update is running: restarts wait until it ends.

result.failed: It did not start again. Its logs tell why.
result.not_found: This service is not installed on the box.
result.timeout: No confirmation after {seconds} seconds. Check its state above.
result.upgrade_in_progress: An update is running. Restart it once the update has ended.
